title: Squalo Divers
specs: Access to over 50 unique dive sites including 38 wrecks and 15 reefs
Warm, crystal-clear waters with diverse marine life including turtles, dolphins, and moray eels
Scuba certification required for dive trips
Children 10-15 must be accompanied by parent or guardian
Children 16-17 need parental supervision or written consent
Divers must have or rent a dive computer
Guided dive mandatory if not dived in last 6-12 months
Refresher class required if not dived in over 13 months
Children under 6 not permitted on boats
Solo divers paired with another diver or dive team unless guide hired

blurb: Guests can join scuba diving excursions from Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Pompano Beach to explore over 50 dive sites including wrecks and reefs. Trips last about four hours with two dives and two tanks, and require scuba certification. Rental gear and dive/snorkel guides are available for an additional fee.
